answer: Time the arrivals, not just the accounts. Each new identity records a millisecond arrival clock, and the ledger clusters joins by inter-arrival gaps: organic recruitment spreads like seed in a garden, while a farm registers in tight bursts of a few hundred milliseconds. A burst above the human-rate delta opens an audit, freezing that batch until every member proves independent work. Honest latecomers cross the oasis freely; scripted swarms stall in the freeze.
